statement: WiiBrew's Extension Controllers encryption setup describes enabling encrypted exchange with value 0xAA at register 0xA400F0 and supplying a 16-byte key at 0xA40040 in three writes of lengths six, six and four. The encrypted byte transform is address-dependent through generated lookup tables. This corroborates the existence of Dolphin/rnconrad encrypted paths but does not resolve their disagreement about precisely when keys regenerate.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documented Wii Remote family; precise physical hardware variant not independently captured
applicability.scope: WiiBrew oldid 121955 section Encryption setup and Registers / Initialization; Dolphin Extension.cpp lines 77-121. No crypto code or 16-byte key disclosed.
